test_title: PYST 9: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

All and sundry
solution:
The correct answer is **'Everyone'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **All and sundry**__**: **Everyone **(सभी)**

 __
 
• **E.g.**__- It was clear to **all and sundry** that something was wrong.&
